description: Higher-A (A=2..7) bigraded GB stratification.  Counts partitions of n=3A by (depth, max-row) cell and checks the q-Plancherel identity Σ dim_q² = [n]_q!. FINDING: the identity holds at A=1 (n=3) and is approximate at higher A — the deviation increases with A, suggesting a missing z-Markov normalization in the proposition's 'sum bounded by 1' claim.

structural_observations.Plancherel_identity_failure_at_high_A: Σ dim_q² / [n]_q! deviates from 1 as A grows; the simple hook formula does not give a Plancherel-bounded measure beyond H_3 in this normalization. To recover Σ w_λ ≤ 1, the canonical Markov trace would need z-prefactors (per pyhecke canonical_isospin implementation).
structural_observations.bigraded_value: The (depth, max-row) bigrading still gives a clean partition count per cell, providing the combinatorial substrate for Term 7 even when weight normalization is imperfect. The DOMINANT cells at each A reveal which (depth, channel) carries most of the Plancherel mass.
